introduction.summary: This specification records the project purpose, stakeholder constraints and unresolved decisions stated in the source evidence below.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-001
items.detail: Design a secure DNS and web-access filtering system for a university that protects students, faculty, staff, and administrative users from malicious or unauthorized internet destinations.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-002
items.detail: The system should inspect DNS requests, block access to known malicious domains, apply different browsing policies based on user roles, and provide administrators with a dashboard for reviewing blocked requests and security events.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-003
items.detail: Administrators should be able to create and update filtering policies, allow approved exceptions, investigate repeated attempts to access blocked resources, and temporarily restrict users when suspicious behavior is detected.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-004
items.detail: The platform should maintain audit logs of policy changes and filtering decisions, integrate with centralized authentication, and support deployment across academic buildings, hostels, laboratories, and administrative offices.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-005
items.detail: The solution should be secure, scalable, reliable, and manageable.

open_issues: how user roles are defined and mapped to browsing policies
what constitutes suspicious behavior and how it is detected
how audit logs are stored and accessed by authorized personnel
whether the system will support real-time threat intelligence feeds

requirements.title: The platform shall maintain audit logs of policy changes and filtering decisions, integrate with centralized authentication, and support deployment across academic buildings, hostels, laboratories, and administrative offices.
requirements.statement: The platform shall maintain audit logs of policy changes and filtering decisions, integrate with centralized authentication, and support deployment across academic buildings, hostels, laboratories, and administrative offices.

acceptance_criteria.given: A system administrator modifies a filtering policy in the university network
acceptance_criteria.when: The policy change is applied to the network configuration
acceptance_criteria.then: An audit log entry is generated recording the timestamp, user identity, action type, and affected resource scope
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the audit log response after policy modification

acceptance_criteria.given: A user attempts to access a domain blocked by role-based filtering policies
acceptance_criteria.when: The system evaluates the request against active policies and authentication status
acceptance_criteria.then: The system either blocks the access or allows it based on defined rules, with a decision recorded in audit logs
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of filtering decision outcome and corresponding log entry

acceptance_criteria.given: Centralized authentication service returns a user identity for an academic building network access request
acceptance_criteria.when: The system receives the identity via integration with centralized authentication
acceptance_criteria.then: The system validates the identity and applies appropriate role-based policies without requiring manual intervention
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of successful authentication flow and policy application

acceptance_criteria.given: The platform is deployed in an academic building, hostel, laboratory, or administrative office environment
acceptance_criteria.when: Network traffic is observed across these physical locations
acceptance_criteria.then: The system maintains consistent filtering and policy enforcement without degradation in performance or availability
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of network behavior before and after deployment in each location

unresolved_decisions: Whether audit logs shall include metadata about the source IP address of policy change initiators
The exact scope of role-based policies across different building types
How policy synchronization is handled during cross-location deployments

items.title: Policy

items.detail: A stored record of an event. Required event scope and retention are determined by the linked source, not this definition.

items.title: Log
items.detail: A collection of event records. This term does not itself require additional logging fields, events or access permissions.
